source: V64 recent declaration: exact active map, daily contract observations, lagged spec proxy; 2018-2025; byte/schema/date preflight before numeric read

signal.mechanism: skewness preference: long lowest historical skew, short highest
signal.skew_estimator: pandas unbiased Fisher-Pearson rolling skew; complete126 consecutive calendar rows; positive sample std greater than1e-12
signal.daily_return: close(t,contract selected before t)/close(previous calendar session,same contract)-1; both closes and volumes positive; never new-contract/old-contract ratio
signal.selection: first completed session of each calendar month; unique minimum and maximum of all4 finite skews; any missing or tied extreme sleeps entire month
signal.between_selections: hold selected asset directions; daily constant fraction resizing and causal active-contract rolls in existing ledger
signal.warmup: 2018-2020 values only for causal trailing features and last monthly state; initial portfolio cash begins2021
signal.control: exact sign mirror with same readiness, sizing and terminal masks; never promote control after observing results

limitations: New economic hypothesis on existing price history, not new information or an independent holdout. Literature concerns commodity futures; applying it to mixed MOEX BR/MIX/RI/SI is an unproven extrapolation, not a replication or evidence of profit.
Only four correlated markets; long/short not cash-risk or beta neutral. Potential crash risk and persistent asset bias; skew estimator noisy. No implied-volatility or option-gamma claim.

Daily exact-contract returns are concatenated at return level across causal rolls, never raw price splices. Missing sessions/zero volume invalidate126-session windows, not compressed away or filled with zero.

Daily candle/spec/fee/margin proxies, not BBO, historical broker tariffs or synchronized execution. One leg can fill without the other; actual gross can move after gaps. No cash interest or live/demo orders.

One fixed126-session/monthly rule and one mirror control. No post-outcome change of sign, asset, period, lookback, capital, masks or costs. Weak result closes this hypothesis; control cannot be promoted.
Stage1 five-percent threshold selects only a potential component; it does not replace the20-50percent annual goal. Goal_verified remains false even on Stage2 promotion.
